title: Kissed Croatian Dried Fruit Wrap
description: A yeasty, shattering Croatian dish featuring dried fruit, leaf wrap steam that is perfect for a snack.
instructions: Combine yeast, 1/2 cup warm water, and 1 tablespoon sugar in a bowl; let sit for 5 minutes.
Combine flour, salt, and remaining sugar in a large bowl.
Add yeast mixture, dried fruit, and vegetable oil to flour mixture; mix until a dough forms.
Knead dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide dough into 4 equal pieces; roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Brush each dough circle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Place a dough circle in the skillet, top with a few pieces of dried fruit, and fold dough over to form a wrap.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
